name: XAUUSD_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT

entry_rules.hypothesis: Volatility compression -> expansion breakout. When M15 ATR drops to bottom 20% (compression), wait for ATR to spike above 70th percentile (expansion), then enter in the direction of M5 Bollinger Band breakout. Trades WITH volatility expansion, not against it — fundamentally different from V1-V7 structure/candle logic.

entry_trigger.condition: M15 ATR >= 70th percentile AND was compressed in prior 10 bars
entry_trigger.buy: M5 close > M5 Bollinger Upper Band (breakout_up)
entry_trigger.sell: M5 close < M5 Bollinger Lower Band (breakdown_down)

stop.description: Below recent 20-bar swing low (buy) or above (sell)

description: V8: volatility-expansion breakout. Trades WITH volatility spikes using M15 ATR percentile + M5 Bollinger Band breakout. A fundamentally different hypothesis from V1-V7 (which all used structure-break or candle-pattern entry logic).

research_results.hypothesis: Volatility compression (M15 ATR in bottom 20%) followed by expansion (M15 ATR above 70th percentile) + M5 Bollinger Band breakout generates directional momentum entry.

grid_search_train.result: NO CONFIG produced >=15 trades in TRAIN window

research_results.validation: N/A — no config met minimum 15-trade threshold
research_results.conclusion: INCONCLUSIVE / NO EDGE. The volatility-expansion breakout approach is too restrictive — combined with ADX>=15, session filter, and BB breakout confirmation, only 12 signals fired across 21,478 TRAIN bars. 3888 parameter combinations could not reach the 15-trade minimum. The M5+M15 data does not support this hypothesis. V8 is inconclusive and rejected.

notes: Research script: research/v8_volatility_breakout.py — no MT5 writes, no live trading, no fabrication. All numbers computed from db/trading.db (XAUUSD M15: 47398 bars, M5: 35797 bars). M5 data covers Feb 2025 to Aug 2026 (~6 months) — shorter than M15 (2yr).
